title: Venusian build.json
description: Build facts of a Venusian app, read by venusian build. Every key is optional.

id.description: Reverse-DNS identity; must equal config/app.php app.id.

build.description: A whole number, one more each release: the .app's CFBundleVersion.

sketch.description: The sketch the packaged app runs; the only one, or asked when several.

icon.description: Square PNG relative to the app root, 16 to 512 px.

description.description: A paragraph; blank lines separate paragraphs.

category.description: A freedesktop main category; the .app maps it to LSApplicationCategoryType.

permissions.description: macOS: what the app asks the user for, each with the sentence macOS shows when it asks.

extensions.description: Extension names beyond what composer.lock declares.

targets.description: Empty means the machine running the build.

env.description: Over the app's .env in the packaged app.

env_except.description: Keys of the app's .env left out of the packaged app.
